name: Lancet
description: Pointed lancet windows nested one inside another, ranked like a cathedral clerestory.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 38%, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 38%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 38%, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 38%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 18%; width: 56%; height: 82%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 32%, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 32%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 32%, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 32%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
